plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-12 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) English - Creative Writing Emphasis program page and its linked official degree map workbook, 'English & English Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'Creative Writing (Campus)' tab, last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/14/14/16/15/15/15/15) and the plan to the catalog's printed BA degree total of 120. BA-only program: the catalog prints a single line, Total Credits, BA Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly; no BS option is printed. The catalog's Bachelor of Arts Degree Requirement is 16 foreign-language credits (four semesters of a foreign language, or testing out and purchasing the credits; one semester may also fulfill the General Education Humanities requirement); the map's four LANG rows (1010/1020/2010/2020 at 4 credits each) satisfy it exactly. The catalog's General Education block prints only Core Course Requirements (12+ credits) and Breadth Area Requirements (16+ credits) with 'See General Education for course options'; the map's GE rows are recorded as printed. The catalog's Free Electives section prints no fixed figure (the total is determined by the General Education courses taken, degree type, additional credits earned and prerequisite courses needed). Catalog-versus-map difference, disclosed, not reconciled: all three English maps print 'LANG 1020 Intermediate Language I' in Fall Year 2, reusing the code printed in Spring Year 1 for LANG 1020 - Beginning Language II; the slot is recorded as LANG 2010 - Intermediate Language I, the third-semester number in SUU's four-semester language sequence as printed on other official SUU degree maps. Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates or substitutes '&' for 'and'. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes. Cross-check: the catalog's English - Creative Writing Curriculum totals 51 credits (Core Required Courses 6 + Creative Writing Core 21 + Advanced Creative Writing Workshops 6 + Literature Options 9 + Department Electives 9), and the map exercises exactly 51 major credits: every named Core and Creative Writing Core course appears, the two generic Advanced Creative Writing Course slots total the Workshops block's 6 credits (options ENGL 4010/4020/4030), the three generic Literature slots total the Literature Options block's 9 credits (the two 3000-level survey slots carry the catalog's two survey groups in map order and the 4000-level slot the catalog's 4000-level list), and the three generic Major Track elective slots total the Department Electives block's 9 credits (the catalog exercises that block as one of seven named tracks -- Administration of Literary Arts; Creative Arts and Entrepreneurship; Editing and Publishing; Environmental Writing; Graduate School; International Studies; Writing about the Arts -- whose component courses vary, including 1- and 2-credit components, so the slots are recorded generically as printed). DISCLOSED catalog ambiguity, not reconciled: after the Department Electives tracks the catalog prints a further list headed 'English Electives - Complete 9 credits from the following' (ENGL 1410, 3110, 3270, 4360, 4530, 4890, 4960, 4965, 4970 and any 4000-level literature course) with no heading credit total of its own; counting it as an additional block would take the curriculum to 60, not the printed 51, and the official map exercises exactly the printed 51, so the plan is recorded at the printed curriculum and degree totals with the extra list disclosed here.
